Approval of Minutes • October 17, 2023, Regular Meeting
Introduction of New or Unfinished Business by Board Members
Requesting the Controller to allot funds and to draw warrants against such funds available or will be available in payment of the following claims against the SFMTA
Approving various routine parking and traffic modifications and making environmental review findings
Authorizing the Director of Transportation, to execute a grant agreement, with the California Department of Transportation
Authorizing the Director of Transportation to approve amendments to two As-Needed Specialized Training Services contracts
Approving a reduced Roadway Shared Spaces Closure of Hayes Street between Gough and Octavia streets
Authorizing the Director of Transportation to issue a Request for Proposals for Consulting Services supporting the Communications-Based Train Control Upgrade Project
Approving an amendment to the SFMTA’s Zero Emission Vehicle (ZEV) Policy
